record.dic_text:
0812 'Eshkol {esh-ko:l'}

與 0811 同; 陽性專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Eshcol 6; 6

以實各 = "串束"
1) 希伯崙地區, 以實各山谷
2) 亞摩利人, 幔利的弟兄, 居住於希伯崙 (#創 14:13,24|)
record.edic_text:
0812 'Eshkol {esh-kole'}

the same as 0811;; n pr loc,m

AV - Eshcol 6; 6

Eshcol = "cluster"
1) an area of Hebron, the valley of Eshcol
2) an Amorite, the brother of Mamre, dwelling in Hebron
